theory.overview: A heap is a complete binary tree with heap property: in min-heap, parent ≤ children; in max-heap, parent ≥ children. Implemented as array where for index i: parent = (i-1)/2, left = 2i+1, right = 2i+2. Heaps enable $O(\log n)$ insert and extract-min/max, making them ideal for priority queues. Used in Dijkstra's algorithm, Huffman coding, heap sort, and scheduling. This chapter covers heap operations, heapify, and heap-based problems.

sections.title: Heap Properties
sections.content: Complete binary tree: all levels filled except possibly last, which is filled left to right. Array representation: index 0 is root. For index i: parent = floor((i-1)/2), left = 2i+1, right = 2i+2. Min-heap: parent ≤ children (root is minimum). Max-heap: parent ≥ children (root is maximum). Heap property maintained through heapify operations.

sections.title: Heap Operations
sections.content: Insert: add at end, bubble up (swap with parent while violating heap property). $O(\log n)$. Extract-min/max: remove root, move last element to root, bubble down (swap with smaller/larger child). $O(\log n)$. Peek: return root. $O(1)$. Build heap: heapify from bottom up. $O(n)$ (not $O(n \log n)$).

sections.title: Heapify
sections.content: Sift-down (bubble down): compare node with children, swap with smaller (min-heap) or larger (max-heap) child, repeat until heap property satisfied. Sift-up (bubble up): compare with parent, swap if violating, repeat. Build heap: start from last non-leaf (index n/2-1), sift-down each. Bottom-up approach ensures $O(n)$ build time.
sections.buildHeap: Start from index n/2-1, sift-down each to end. Total O(n).

sections.title: Priority Queue
sections.content: Priority queue abstracts heap operations: insert (enqueue), extract-min/max (dequeue), peek. Used when elements have priorities. Min-heap for smallest first, max-heap for largest first. Applications: task scheduling, Dijkstra's algorithm (min-heap for closest unvisited node), Huffman coding (min-heap for combining least frequent characters).

sections.title: Heap Sort
sections.content: In-place sorting using heap. Build max-heap from array. Repeatedly extract max (swap root with last, sift-down new root). Elements accumulate at end in sorted order. Time: $O(n \log n)$. Space: $O(1)$ (in-place). Not stable but efficient and guaranteed $O(n \log n)$.
sections.algorithm: Build max-heap. For i from n-1 to 1: swap arr[0] with arr[i], sift-down arr[0] in heap of size i.

keyConcepts.name: Complete Binary Tree
keyConcepts.description: All levels filled except possibly last, which is filled left to right. Enables compact array representation.
keyConcepts.benefit: No wasted space, easy index calculations

keyConcepts.name: Heap Property
keyConcepts.description: Min-heap: parent ≤ children. Max-heap: parent ≥ children. Ensures root is min/max.
keyConcepts.maintenance: Sift-up on insert, sift-down on extract

keyConcepts.name: Array Representation
keyConcepts.description: Index 0 is root. For i: parent = (i-1)/2, left = 2i+1, right = 2i+2. No pointer overhead.

keyConcepts.name: Build Heap O(n)
keyConcepts.description: Bottom-up heapify from last non-leaf. Each sift-down is O(h), but most nodes are near bottom, total O(n).
keyConcepts.proof: Sum of heights × number of nodes at each height = O(n)

steps.title: Insert
steps.description: Add element at end of array. Sift-up: compare with parent, swap if violating heap property.
steps.code: heap.push(val); i = heap.length - 1; while i > 0 and heap[parent(i)] > heap[i]: swap(i, parent(i)); i = parent(i);

steps.title: Extract Min
steps.description: Swap root with last element. Remove last. Sift-down new root: swap with smaller child until heap property satisfied.
steps.code: min = heap[0]; heap[0] = heap.pop(); i = 0; while left child exists: swap with smaller child if needed;

steps.title: Sift-Down
steps.description: Compare node with children. Swap with smaller (min-heap) or larger (max-heap) child. Repeat until heap property satisfied.
steps.code: while left(i) < n: smallest = left(i); if right(i) < n and heap[right] < heap[smallest]: smallest = right(i); if heap[i] <= heap[smallest]: break; swap(i, smallest); i = smallest;

steps.title: Build Heap
steps.description: Start from last non-leaf (n/2-1). Sift-down each node from bottom to top.
steps.code: for i from n/2-1 down to 0: sift_down(i, n);

steps.title: Heap Sort
steps.description: Build max-heap. Repeatedly extract max to end of array.
steps.code: build_max_heap(); for i from n-1 to 1: swap(arr[0], arr[i]); sift_down(0, i);

practiceProblems.title: Kth Largest Element
practiceProblems.description: Find kth largest element in unsorted array.
practiceProblems.solution: Min-heap of size k. Push first k elements. For remaining, if > heap[0], replace. Heap[0] is kth largest.
practiceProblems.hints: Min-heap of size k, keep k largest

practiceProblems.title: Top K Frequent Elements
practiceProblems.description: Return k most frequent elements.
practiceProblems.solution: Count frequencies. Min-heap of size k by (count, element). Keep k most frequent.

practiceProblems.title: Merge K Sorted Lists
practiceProblems.description: Merge k sorted linked lists into one sorted list.
practiceProblems.solution: Min-heap of (value, list, index). Push first node of each list. Extract min, push next from that list.

practiceProblems.title: Find Median from Data Stream
practiceProblems.description: Find median of numbers as they arrive (stream).
practiceProblems.solution: Two heaps: max-heap for lower half, min-heap for upper half. Balance sizes. Median is average of tops or one top.
practiceProblems.hints: Max-heap for lower half, min-heap for upper half

practiceProblems.title: Kth Smallest Element in Matrix
practiceProblems.description: Find kth smallest element in sorted matrix (each row/col sorted).
practiceProblems.solution: Min-heap of (value, row, col). Initialize with first column. Extract k times, push next from same row.

practiceProblems.title: Task Scheduler
practiceProblems.description: Find least intervals to execute tasks with cooldown n between same tasks.
practiceProblems.solution: Count frequencies. Max-heap by frequency. Execute tasks, track cooldown with queue.
practiceProblems.hints: Max-heap by frequency, queue for cooldown

practiceProblems.title: Reorganize String
practiceProblems.description: Rearrange string so no two adjacent characters are same.
practiceProblems.solution: Max-heap by character count. Always pick most frequent not same as previous. If any count > (n+1)/2, impossible.

practiceProblems.title: Ugly Number II
practiceProblems.description: Find nth ugly number (prime factors only 2,3,5).
practiceProblems.solution: Min-heap. Start with 1. Extract min, push min*2, min*3, min*5. Use set to avoid duplicates.

practiceProblems.title: Super Ugly Number
practiceProblems.description: Find nth super ugly number (prime factors from given list).
practiceProblems.solution: Min-heap. Start with 1. Extract min, push min * each prime. Set to avoid duplicates.

practiceProblems.title: IPO
practiceProblems.description: Maximize capital with k projects (each has capital requirement and profit).
practiceProblems.solution: Sort projects by capital. Min-heap for available projects by profit. Do k times: add all affordable to heap, extract max profit.
practiceProblems.hints: Sort by capital, min-heap by profit

practiceProblems.title: Find K Pairs with Smallest Sums
practiceProblems.description: Find k pairs with smallest sums from two sorted arrays.
practiceProblems.solution: Min-heap of (sum, i, j). Initialize with pairs from first array with nums2[0]. Extract k times, push (i, j+1).

practiceProblems.title: K Closest Points to Origin
practiceProblems.description: Find k closest points to origin (0,0).
practiceProblems.solution: Max-heap of size k by distance squared. If heap full and new point closer, replace.
practiceProblems.hints: Max-heap of size k by distance

practiceProblems.title: Kth Smallest Element in Sorted Matrix (Binary Search)
practiceProblems.description: Find kth smallest using binary search on value range.
practiceProblems.solution: Binary search on value range. Count elements ≤ mid using row/col property. Adjust search based on count.
practiceProblems.hints: Binary search on value, count ≤ mid

practiceProblems.title: Sliding Window Maximum
practiceProblems.description: Find max in each sliding window of size k.
practiceProblems.solution: Monotonic decreasing deque (not heap). Store indices. Remove outside window, remove smaller from back.

practiceProblems.title: Data Stream as Disjoint Intervals
practiceProblems.description: Maintain disjoint intervals as numbers arrive in stream.
practiceProblems.solution: TreeMap (ordered map) of intervals. On add, find left and right intervals, merge if overlapping.

practiceProblems.title: Rearrange String k Distance Apart
practiceProblems.description: Rearrange so same characters at least k apart.
practiceProblems.solution: Max-heap by frequency. Queue for cooldown. Place most frequent, add to cooldown queue.

practiceProblems.title: Minimum Number of Refueling Stops
practiceProblems.description: Find minimum refueling stops to reach target with given stations.
practiceProblems.solution: Max-heap of fuel from passed stations. When can't reach next, refuel from heap (max fuel).

practiceProblems.title: Kth Largest Element in a Stream
practiceProblems.description: Design class to find kth largest in stream.
practiceProblems.solution: Min-heap of size k. Maintain k largest elements. Heap[0] is kth largest.

practiceProblems.title: Last Stone Weight
practiceProblems.description: Smash stones: take two heaviest, smash (difference), add back if non-zero.
practiceProblems.solution: Max-heap. While heap > 1: extract two, smash, add difference if > 0.

practiceProblems.title: Furthest Building You Can Reach
practiceProblems.description: Find furthest building reachable with ladders and bricks.
practiceProblems.solution: Use ladders for largest jumps. Min-heap of ladder jumps. When ladder count exceeded, replace largest ladder jump with bricks.

practiceProblems.title: Consecutive Numbers Sum
practiceProblems.description: Given positive integer n, return number of ways to write as sum of consecutive positive integers.
practiceProblems.solution: For length k, check if n - k(k-1)/2 is positive and divisible by k.

practiceProblems.title: Seat Reservation Manager
practiceProblems.description: Design seat manager with reserve and unreserve operations.
practiceProblems.solution: Min-heap of available seats. On reserve, pop min. On unreserve, push back.

practiceProblems.title: The k Weakest Rows in a Matrix
practiceProblems.description: Find k weakest rows (sorted by soldier count, then row index).
practiceProblems.solution: Count soldiers in each row. Min-heap of (count, index). Extract k times.

practiceProblems.title: Find K Closest Elements
practiceProblems.description: Find k closest elements to target in sorted array.
practiceProblems.solution: Binary search to find insertion point. Two pointers expand outward. Or max-heap of size k by distance.
practiceProblems.hints: Binary search + two pointers or max-heap

practiceProblems.title: Kth Smallest Prime Fraction
practiceProblems.description: Find kth smallest fraction formed by arr[i]/arr[j] where i < j.
practiceProblems.solution: Min-heap of (value, i, j). Initialize with arr[i]/arr[n-1] for all i. Extract k times, push (i, j-1).

minigame.title: Heap Master
minigame.description: Master heap operations! Insert, extract, and visualize heap structure.

visualizer.title: Heap Operations Visualizer
visualizer.description: Visualize heap insert, extract, sift-up, sift-down step by step.

snippets.title: Min-Heap Implementation
snippets.code:
import heapq

heap = []
heapq.heappush(heap, 5)
heapq.heappush(heap, 3)
heapq.heappush(heap, 8)

min_val = heapq.heappop(heap)  # Returns 3
print(heap[0])  # Peek: 5
